sentences.en: The speaker was so famous as to need no introduction.
sentences.zh: 这位演讲者如此有名，根本不需要介绍。

sentences.en: The speaker was so well-known as to need no introduction.
sentences.zh: 这位演讲者如此出名，根本不需要介绍。

sentences.en: Mr Gilmore is so well-known as to need no introduction.
sentences.zh: 吉尔莫先生如此知名，根本不需要介绍。

senses.zh: 介绍，引见 - 引言，导论 - 引进，传入；采用 - 新采用的东西
